heard: Sleeping radio operator missed the Titanic. The S.S. Californian sat motionless in the ice. Cyril Evans sent an ice warning earlier. The Titanic operator told him to shut up. Exhausted, Evans switched off his wireless and went to bed. Minutes later, white rockets arced into the night sky. Captain Stanley Lord dismissed the flares. Nobody woke the operator because a sleeping radio operator MissTheTitanic.
